text:
Nina: Quick ops thread  launch posts + benchmark narrative + webinar routing. Need checklist: sitemap entries, JSON-LD, redirects for 8 legacy slugs, and HubSpot hidden UTMs. Who can pick items?
Rahul: I can compile redirects + canonical list. Quick Netlify examples to start:```
/old-launch-2022  /launch-2026  301!
/campaign/benchmark-old  /benchmark/2026  301!
```
Tess: I'll do JSON-LD for the benchmark article and Event for the webinar. Small Event scaffold (fill speakers/time):```
<script type="application/ld+json">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Launch: Benchmarks & Demo",
  "startDate": "2026-06-10T17:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar"}
}
</script>```
Tess: Article JSON-LD will include mainEntityOfPage, headline, author, datePublished and description.
Nina: UTM naming proposal: utm_source=organic|paid, utm_medium=cta|email|social, utm_campaign=launch_jun2026. HubSpot hidden fields: campaign=launch_jun2026, lead_source=organic. Leads -> HS list "Launch_Jun2026" and Zap -> SFDC queue Marketing_Webinar.
Rahul: Will add canonical stripping rules for utm_* and ensure paginated pages use rel=prev/next and only page=1 in sitemap.
SEO Bot: Reminder: noindex tag archives and low-quality auto-generated pages. Add rel=canonical to tags that duplicate content.
Nina: Owners: Rahul = redirects + canonical list (PR by EOD), Tess = JSON-LD + internal link map (by tomorrow morning), I'll coordinate HubSpot fields with CS. React with :white_check_mark: to ack.
Rahul: \u2705 will open PR after list.
Tess: \u2705 working on JSON-LD and anchor text variations.
Nina: Thanks  I'll drop the prelaunch QA checklist and set a 15m runway call the morning of launch. :rocket:
